This portrait mod changes all [b]bachelor [/b]and [b]bachelorette portraits[/b].

Up until now, this mod does NOT contain the beach and winter portraits. Please have patience as I am still working on that.

[u]Please note that the mod requires Portraiture to work.[/u]


[size=3][u]REQUIREMENTS[/u]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999][size=3]Portraiture[/size][/url]
[/list]
[u]HOW TO INSTALL[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI
[*]Extract all the Portraiture into your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder
[*]Put the "mibaho's High-Res Portraits" folder inside Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits 
[*]Run the game using SMAPI and press P in the in-game dialogue to switch the portraits
[/list]
